title: UserHoverCard
wrapsNative: Button with the Monarch link style and popover(isPresented:arrowEdge:content:) with presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover), holding MonarchAvatar, Text and MonarchButton; .redacted(reason: .placeholder) while the profile loads
summary: A recipe, not a component: tapping a person's name or avatar opens a small profile preview with their photo, name, handle, role, status and actions.
whenToUse: Where people's names appear in content (assignees, comments, mentions) and a quick look at who they are saves opening the profile.
whenNotToUse: Not for the full profile (push a profile screen). Not for your own status (use MonarchMyStatus).
api: MonarchAvatar(url: user.photoURL, name: user.name, seed: user.id, size: .lg, status: user.presence)

states.name: closed
states.description: The name in the inline link style.

states.name: open
states.description: A popover with the avatar and presence, the name, handle and role, the status line, details and actions.

states.name: loading
states.description: Details fetched on open are drawn with .redacted(reason: .placeholder) and read as "Loading profile".

appearance: The popover takes the raised background role; the avatar uses its presence dot; text uses the subheading and caption styles; actions are small secondary and ghost buttons.
platformNotes: The web's UserHoverCard opens when a pointer rests on a name or when it gets keyboard focus. Touch has no hover, so on iOS a tap opens the preview, and presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover) keeps it a popover on iPhone instead of a sheet. For a long-press preview of a whole row, use contextMenu(menuItems:preview:) instead. Android composes the same recipe.
accessibility: The name is a button with the hint "Shows a profile preview" and a 44-point touch target.
The popover is a container named "Profile of Sam Rivera"; the name in it has the header trait.
The avatar is read with its presence, such as "Sam Rivera, Busy".
VoiceOver moves into the popover when it opens, and the escape gesture closes it.
Message and View profile are buttons with 44-point touch targets.
edgeCases: Fetch the profile when the popover opens, and show the placeholder until it arrives.
A long role or status wraps inside the popover.
On iPad with a pointer, the same popover can also open from onHover.
